# Meltemi

[![CI](https://github.com/askenaz-dev/meltemi/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg?branch=main)](https://github.com/askenaz-dev/meltemi/actions/workflows/ci.yml)

**The spec-driven control plane for agentic development.** It orchestrates the coding agents you
already use, under a discipline where no line is written without a reviewed specification.

_Léeme en español: [LEEME.md](LEEME.md)._

## Install

Start with the [quickstart](docs/quickstart.md), then bring a model of your own with the
[local models guide](docs/local-models.md). The licence is in [LICENSE](LICENSE).
